# objects { #crossrepo.cache.objects }

```python
crossrepo.cache.objects(root=None)
```

List every object the store holds.

Readable hard links are not listed, since they stand for objects listed
already, and neither are the temporary files of writes still in flight.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**root**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Cache root. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.cache_root`).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Paths of the stored objects, in a stable order.
